heading_path: 21.10  Notification of withdrawal of application etc.
text: If an application, notice or request is withdrawn in accordance with regulation 21.9, the Registrar must publish the withdrawal in a computer database maintained by the Trade Marks Office.
title: Notification of withdrawal of application etc.
